long_contract.note: GDD 11.2 long contract: monthly pay; a few random roles per board are marked house roles and only those may be signed; house roles give the player's main color +n style points; after a refusal it returns a quarter later

drug.note: Step 12c. The boost is a free action before any period (at most once per period), unlocked by accepting evt_offer_drug (flag unlock_flag). Not allowed when discipline >= refuse_discipline

arrest.note: Step 12c. fine = max(fine_min, money x fine_pct%), never more than the money held (not below 0); the next detain_periods periods are void (detention)
arrest.raid_note: search probability of a crime job = prob x (1 + crime / raid_crime_div)
arrest.raid_check_note: Step 12c c3: when searched, r0(raid_skill displayed) + raid_check_add >= raid_line passes; otherwise arrest
